definitions.explanation: The manufacturing of goods in large quantities, typically using standardized processes and assembly lines. A shortened form of 大量生産.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{量産|りょうさん}{体制|たいせい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: This product has entered mass production.

examples.japanese: {量産|りょうさん}によってコストが{大幅|おおはば}に{下|さ}がった。
{試作品|しさくひん}は{完成|かんせい}したが、{量産|りょうさん}するにはまだ{課題|かだい}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: The prototype is complete, but there are still challenges remaining before mass production.

notes:
An abbreviation of {大量|たいりょう}{生産|せいさん} (mass production). The abbreviated form {量産|りょうさん} is more commonly used in everyday business and manufacturing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {量産|りょうさん}する (to mass-produce)
- {量産|りょうさん}{体制|たいせい} (mass production system)
- {量産|りょうさん}{品|ひん} (mass-produced goods)
- {量産|りょうさん}{型|がた} (mass-production model)
- {量産|りょうさん}{化|か} (transition to mass production)

Often contrasted with {手作|てづく}り (handmade) or {少量|しょうりょう}{生産|せいさん} (small-batch production). Also used figuratively and humorously to describe producing something in large quantities, e.g., "churning out" reports or content.
